title: ChatCompleted (v1)
description: One chat request finished. The usage record for cost, quotas and the dashboard. Written by the gateway. doc_id is null; retrieved documents are listed in data.

source.description: Only these services may write ChatCompleted.

data.description: Only facts a consumer needs to act; nothing that can be looked up. Unknown fields tolerated (additive v1).

model.description: Public model name requested (e.g. llm, docs).

backend.description: Which LLM answered: vLLM on the GPU node, or Bedrock (warm-up bridge / fallback). Feeds the cost dashboard (Step 11).

latency_ms.description: Wall time from request to last byte.

api_key_id.description: Hashed identifier of the API key, never the key. Per-key quotas and logs key on it.

retrieved_doc_ids.description: Documents whose chunks were used as context (empty for plain chat).
